top_choice_rationale: P002 (Katori and Ye, optical lattice clocks) is a single bounded invention, magic-wavelength trapping of many neutral atoms, that is distinct from the 2005 frequency-comb and 2012 single-ion prizes, and its realisation at the 1e-18 level with controlled collective shifts is reproduced across laboratories and checked in international comparisons. The two-name allocation matches the achievement with no forced cut, unlike P001, where the omission of Bernevig, Hughes and Zhang leaves the experimental half of the credit unresolved, and unlike P003, where the experimental slot overlaps Wineland's 2012 prize. P001 is a close second on conceptual reach; P003 and P004 are mature but weaker on exact attribution; no award is the least preferred.
recusal_note: Field proximity to precision atomic physics and a past research stay in John Hall's laboratory in Boulder (Jun Ye works in the JILA environment), with no documented personal or collaborative tie to Katori or Ye; my quantum-information work is also close to the trapped-ion proposal P003. I would recuse if the committee judged these connections material.
